title: MENFIT Power Trial 2.0 Prospective, double-blind, randomized, multicenter, placebo-controlled observational study of MENFIT® Power Caps.
summary: Evaluation of herbal active ingredients from Ayurveda and TCM with regard to clinical efficacy and safety in men with erectile dysfunction and prostate problems using the product MENFIT® Power.
conditions: Men with erectile dysfunction and mild prostate problems.

interventions.name: 100 patients with mild to moderate erectile dysfunction (IIEF-5: 12 - 21 pts and mild to moderate prostate problems (IPSS: 5-19 pts) who receive the study medication MENFIT Power Caps twice daily.
100 patients with mild to moderate erectile dysfunction (IIEF-5: 12 - 21 pts and mild to moderate prostate symptoms (IPSS: 5-19 pts) who receive a placebo twice daily.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Men with mild to moderate erectile dysfunction (IIEF-5: 12 - 21 pts and mild to moderate prostate problems (IPSS: 5-19 pts).
Exclusion criteria:
Hormone therapy (e.g. testosterone substitution), long-term therapy with PDE-5 inhibitors or an alpha blocker (e.g. tamsulosin, alfuzosin, silodosin) or a 5-alpha 
reductase inhibitor (finasteride, dutasteride).
